questions.question: ​Aditya ranked 34th from the top and 44th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
Rank from top: 34

Rank from bottom: 44

Total students: (Rank from top + Rank from bottom) - 1

= (34 + 44 ) - 1

= 78 - 1

=77

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**: Some trees are chisels. Some chisels are graphs.

**Conclusions (I)**: Some trees are graphs.

**Conclusions (II)**: All graphs are chisels.
questions.solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d8f8cb072fae55d15395578b22f42ac2c0dbd310dda542e7835cf5baacce8f3.png] 

Conclusions (I): Some trees are graphs.- False (As their is no direct relation between trees and graph may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Conclusions (II): All graphs are chisels. - False (Some chisels are graphs and some graph are chisels but all graphs are chisels is may be possible but not definite. Hence, it is false).

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
